s.note: Chips under beef chilli, cheddar and jalapeños
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once. Meanwhile brown 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, add 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp chilli powder, 400g tin crushed tomatoes and a drained 400g tin kidney beans, and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Pile the chips into a baking dish, spoon over the chilli, scatter with 150g grated cheddar and grill 3 minutes until melted. Top with 100g sour cream, sliced jalapeños and spring onion.

s.note: Chewy salted twists with spiced apple butter and hot mustard
s.how: Divide 500g pizza dough into 8 pieces, roll each into a 50cm rope and twist into pretzels. Bring 2L water and 60g bicarb to a simmer and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Lay on a lined tray, brush with 1 beaten egg, sprinkle with sea salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes until deep brown. For the apple butter, simmer 4 peeled diced apples with 60g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 100ml apple juice for 25 minutes and mash smooth. Serve with American mustard.

m.n: Amish chicken and noodles over mash
m.note: Shredded chicken and thick egg noodles in peppery broth over buttery mash
m.how: Simmer 800g chicken thighs in 1.5L chicken stock with 1 diced onion, 2 diced carrots and 2 celery sticks for 35 minutes. Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot. Add 300g wide egg noodles and simmer 8 minutes until the broth thickens. Season well with salt and plenty of white pepper. Meanwhile boil 1kg peeled potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Ladle the chicken and noodles over the mash and scatter with chopped parsley.

m.note: Beef chuck braised slowly with onions, carrots and potatoes, gravy from the pot
m.how: Season 1.4kg beef chuck roast and sear on all sides in 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot. Add 2 onions cut in wedges and 2 tbsp tomato paste, then 750ml beef stock and 3 sprigs thyme. Cover and cook at 160C for 2 hours. Add 4 carrots and 800g potatoes in chunks, cover again and cook for 1 hour more, until the beef falls apart. Lift out the beef and vegetables, thicken the pot juices with 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with water and simmer into gravy. Pull the beef into chunks and serve with the vegetables and gravy.

w.note: Straight from Ishmael's Amish country. Sticky molasses pie, brown sugar crumb
w.how: Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry. Rub 150g plain flour, 100g brown sugar and 60g cold butter into crumbs. Whisk 150ml molasses, 1 egg and 180ml hot water with 1 tsp bicarb. Pour into the pastry case, then scatter the crumbs evenly over the top. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes, then drop to 180C for 30 minutes until just set with a slight wobble. Cool 30 minutes and serve with 200ml whipped cream.

d.note: Not Big Ern's Tanqueray and Tab. Vanilla ice cream, milk and malt, blended thick
d.how: Chill 4 tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Blend 600ml cold full cream milk with 1L vanilla ice cream, 5 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla extract until thick and smooth. Pour into the cold glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks, spoon on top and sprinkle each with a little more malt powder. Serve straight away with thick straws.
